LEAGUE_ENVIRONMENT_BASELINE.reads: the subject under the stated conditions, against the competition-season environment mean of the same metric

OPPONENT_OVERALL_BASELINE.reads: the fixture opponent under the stated conditions, against the opponent's unrestricted all-prior mean

OPPONENT_VENUE_BASELINE.reads: the fixture opponent under the stated conditions, against its mean at the venue it occupies in the target fixture

SIMILAR_OPPONENT_COHORT.reads: the subject against opponents deterministically similar to the fixture opponent, versus the subject against the remaining opponents

SUBJECT_COMPETITION_BASELINE.reads: the subject inside the target competition, against its cross-competition all-prior mean

SUBJECT_CONDITIONAL_VS_BASELINE.reads: the subject under the stated conditions, against the subject when those conditions do NOT hold

SUBJECT_OVERALL_BASELINE.reads: the subject under its own stated conditions, against the subject's unrestricted all-prior mean

SUBJECT_RECENT_VS_LONG_BASELINE.reads: the subject's time-decayed recent weighting of its prior matches, against the un-decayed long-run mean of its whole prior history

SUBJECT_VENUE_BASELINE.reads: the subject under its own stated conditions, against the subject's mean at the venue it occupies in the target fixture

SUBJECT_VS_FIXTURE_OPPONENT.reads: the subject's own rate against the corresponding rate of the team it actually faces in the target fixture

competition.means: restrict to prior matches played in the same competition as the target fixture

historical_venue_conditioning.means: restrict the entity's prior matches to those played at that venue

opponent_profile.means: restrict to prior matches whose OPPONENT sat in that PIT tercile of the named profile axis, within the opponent's own competition

known_unsupported_dimensions.opponent_formation_family: formation is not resolvable per prior match in this corpus
known_unsupported_dimensions.own_formation_family: formation is not resolvable per prior match in this corpus
